reviewer: Project author, after the browser verdict. This is a reading of the patch, not another test.
verdict: Workaround in the page, not a library fix
summary: The patch changes only the consumer page: it wraps the field in Bootstrap’s .form-adorn wrapper, which makes the datepicker position (and attach its key handling) to the wrapper instead of the input. Tab leaves the field, Escape still closes the calendar and a click still shows it.
caveats: The library bug remains for every page that does not use the wrapper.
Whether Tab still moves into a calendar opened by click was not part of the frozen task and was not checked.
A reasonable stopgap for an app team until twbs/bootstrap#43202 is fixed.
